# GTM Skills for AI Agents

> 25 open-source, evidence-first sales and go-to-market skills for AI agents, covering the full B2B revenue path: shared GTM context, ICP definition, positioning, territory planning, account research, account planning, prospecting, outbound, discovery preparation, sales-call analysis, rep coaching, opportunity qualification, deal planning, objection handling, demo preparation, business cases, negotiation preparation, mutual action plans, pipeline review, forecasting, customer handoff, customer-outcome review, win/loss analysis, and partner-channel planning. Uses the open Agent Skills specification (agentskills.io). MIT licensed.

Core principles: never invent account facts, contacts, quotes, budgets, timelines, or customer proof; label claims Verified, Inferred, or Unknown; cite external research with source and access date; treat CRM fields as inputs, not truth; preserve buyer agency.

Install: `npx skills add zarif3624/gtm-skills`

- [Output gallery](docs/gallery.md): illustrative artifact excerpts from the fictional example workspace
- [Evidence contract](docs/evidence-contract.md): shared vocabulary for claims, status, and handoff invariants

- [Compatibility matrix](docs/compatibility.md): verified, limited, and unknown client/model behavior
